以下、リクエストになります。

・内容

車種はジープ ラングラーのようなゴツめの車．

レンチやバット，方位磁石，ヘルメットなどのサバイバルアイテムを取り入れていただけると嬉しいです．
配信サムネイルでも使用させていただければと考えており、１：１ もしくは １６：９ に近しい比率に仕上げていただければと思います。
また、背景が透過されたデータがあるとありがたいです。

・資料
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lXJPZNotf4_HtRyRj693NLE2TKKT5mHg/view?usp=sharing (上着あり)
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FcaWB4IAyi4YmkGEUzXbgnl4yVxE8JRU/view?usp=sharing (上着なし)

ご検討のほどよろしくお願いいたします。

Hell there!  I saw some artwork you did of my favorite vtuber Ashton Marten and really liked your style and would like to see more of your beautiful work!  I was thinking of Ashton Marten car camping during the summer, where you sleep in or next to a car, sitting next to a campfire at night as though at the end of a long day, roasting a marshmallow on a stick over the fire.  I would like it if you could include her chinchillas, they could be sleeping, playing, roasting a marshmallow, or whatever you prefer as long as it is cute.  I would like it if there was camping gear around and Ashton looking up at the night sky.  If you wish, feel free to include objects from your previous skeb of her, or do something entirely new, it is up to you.  Thank you!
